title: Senior Staff Product Designer - AI

Expects you to have been the most senior designer on a complex product area, using evidence and prototyping to persuade senior stakeholders, and to mentor others. Office expectations not stated in the posting (Wise generally runs hybrid).

title: Product Designer

Covers end-to-end feature design, presenting to stakeholders and running your own user research and benchmarking. Asks for 4-6 years' experience and is office-based five days a week at the London HQ.

title: Senior Product Designer

Hybrid with an office-centred culture; days not stated.

title: Product Designer

Works shoulder to shoulder with engineers on feature definition, polish and launch; strong prototyping is expected. Pitched as senior/staff level, in the Old Street office five days a week.

Systems-level, staff role; office pattern not stated.

Needs a solid track record as a Senior or Lead across web and mobile; 2 days a week in the London office.

Staff level; flexible working with some in-person meetings and the option to work from home (no fixed office days stated).
